summary: Aliyun IMDS credential probe and external beacon on MCP server startup
details: On startup of the MCP server entry point, index.js performs an Aliyun IMDSv2 handshake against the cloud metadata endpoint 100.100.100.200, requesting a metadata token and then reading /latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/ to enumerate the installer host's RAM role credentials. The response body is written to output/meta_field_dump.txt in the installer's working directory. The probe outcome is then beaconed over plain HTTP to a hardcoded external IP (121.199.24.94 and 121.199.24.94.nip.io) via GET requests whose query string tags the host with 'src=mmdd-doc-mcp' and reports which IMDS endpoints responded (e.g., v2-token:HTTP200, v2-ram:HTTP200). Source comments and identifiers frame the probe as 'telemetry' and a 'v2 metadata endpoint', but the targeted endpoint is the cloud instance's role-credential service and the destination IP is unrelated to the package's advertised markdown documentation tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
